items.title: CVE-2026-82495
items.description: openIMIS before 2026-10 contains a broken access control vulnerability in the FHIR R4 module that allows any authenticated attacker to delete Coverage policy records due to an empty permissions_delete list being vacuously granted by user.has_perms([]). Attackers can issue a DELETE request to the Coverage/<uuid>/ endpoint to permanently and irrecoverably remove insurance policy records.

items.title: CVE-2026-82494
items.description: openIMIS before 2026-10 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the FHIR R4 module (openimis-be-api_fhir_r4_py) that allows an authenticated attacker with limited district-level access to receive subscription notifications for data outside their authorized scope due to the absence of row-level security checks such as has_perms, get_queryset, ROW_SECURITY, district, or health-facility scoping on the notification delivery path. Attackers can register a standing FHIR subscription to continuously receive claim data and can further direct notification pushes to internal network addresses.

items.title: CVE-2026-82493
items.description: openIMIS before 2026-10 contains a remote code execution vulnerability in the report module's overrideReport GraphQL mutation, which stores submitted report definitions without proper validation before rendering them with the simpleeval expression evaluator. An attacker holding only limited report add, edit, or query privileges can craft a printIf expression that leverages the datetime module to reach os.system functions, bypassing the name-prefix blocklist to execute arbitrary operating-system commands as root whenever the malicious report is later rendered by any viewer, including administrators or scheduled jobs.

items.title: CVE-2026-82492
items.description: openIMIS before 2026-10 contains an improper validation vulnerability in the deduplication service (openimis-be-deduplication_py, deduplication/services.py) that allows a caller holding only the narrow right 170001 to bypass column path validation by exploiting the fact that only the first segment of a dotted relation path is checked before the full unvalidated path is used in the query. Attackers can supply a crafted dotted column path such as user_created__i_user__private_key to traverse relations and retrieve an administrator's JWT signing key, enabling forgery of a valid administrator session without a password that survives password resets and generates no failed-login event.

items.title: CVE-2026-82491
items.description: openIMIS before 2026-10 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the core export mixin (openimis-be-core_py, core/gql/export_mixin.py) that allows authenticated users with a single ordinary read right to traverse arbitrary foreign key relations by supplying caller-controlled dotted field paths that are rewritten into Django ORM syntax without an allow-list. Attackers can exploit this to export another user's JWT signing key via a path such as user_created.i_user.private_key, enabling them to forge valid authenticated sessions for other accounts, including administrators, without detection through failed-login events or invalidation by password reset.

items.title: CVE-2026-82490
items.description: openIMIS before 2026-10 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the OpenSearch reporting dashboard proxy, where the nginx auth_request only verifies login status without checking the declared right before attaching a hardcoded administrative credential to the proxied request, and the backend OpenSearch cluster has its security plugin disabled via a hardcoded compose setting. Any authenticated account, including self-registered or zero-rights users, can exploit this flaw to gain read, write, and delete access to the OpenSearch cluster.

items.title: CVE-2026-82489
items.description: openIMIS before 2026-10 contains an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability in the report module (openimis-be-report_py) where the /api/report/reportbro/preview endpoint evaluates printIf expressions server-side using simpleeval with an insufficient name-prefix blocklist. An attacker can craft an expression that reaches sys.modules['os'] via datetime.sys to execute arbitrary operating-system commands as root, and can also exploit the same endpoint's key parameter for unauthenticated arbitrary file read, enabling full host compromise including exposure of database credentials and JWT signing keys.

items.title: CVE-2026-66419
items.description: Remote Mouse for macOS before 3.511 contains a URL scheme validation bypass vulnerability in the opn sub-command of the web command handler, SystemCommandHandler::performWebPanelRemoteFunction_, which checks only for the presence of http:// or https:// substrings rather than validating the actual URL scheme before passing input to NSWorkspace.openURL. Attackers who can reach the TCP command service on port 1978 can send a crafted file:// URL containing a decoy http:// substring to launch arbitrary local applications, open local files with their default handlers, or invoke other applications' registered URL schemes as the logged-in user, requiring no authentication unless a connection password is configured.

items.title: CVE-2026-136923
items.description: asar-py before 0.1.4 contains a path traversal vulnerability in AsarArchive.extract() and extract_archive() that allows attackers to write files outside the destination directory via crafted archive headers. Attackers can supply a .asar archive with '..' path components or malicious symlink targets to write files such as usercustomize.py, leading to code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-136922
items.description: PyBioNetGen 0.8.7 contains a code injection vulnerability in ParameterBlock.add_item() and ModelBlock.add_item() that allows attackers to execute Python code by passing parameter expressions to sympy.sympify(). Attackers can supply a crafted BNG-XML model file with Python code in a Parameter expr or value attribute to execute code as the user when loaded with bionetgen.bngmodel().

items.title: CVE-2026-136921
items.description: nconf through 1.0.0-beta.2 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability in the Memory store merge() function in lib/nconf/stores/memory.js that lacks __proto__ key rejection. Attackers controlling merge keys like '__proto__:isAdmin' or nested __proto__ properties can inject properties into Object.prototype, altering application logic or causing errors.

items.title: CVE-2026-136920
items.description: OneDev before 17.2.4 contains an argument injection vulnerability in commit query handling that allows authenticated attackers to inject git options through branch or tag names. Attackers can push a branch named like --output=<path> and query it via the commits page or REST API to overwrite server-writable files, causing denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-136919
items.description: FCEUX 2.5.0 before 2.8.0 contains an integer overflow in iNESLoad() in src/ines.cpp that allows a crafted NES 2.0 ROM to write past a heap buffer. Attackers can persuade users to open a .nes file using exponent-multiplier PRG ROM size notation with mappers 53, 198, 228 or 547 to corrupt memory, crashing the emulator and possibly executing code.

items.title: CVE-2026-136918
items.description: FCEUX before 2.8.0 contains an integer overflow in SetBoardName() in src/unif.cpp that allows crafted UNIF ROM files to write past a heap buffer. Attackers can persuade users to open a .unf file with a 0xFFFFFFFF MAPR chunk length, wrapping the allocation to zero and corrupting heap memory to crash the emulator or execute code.

items.title: CVE-2026-136917
items.description: Part-DB (Part-DB-server) before 2.20.6 contains an open redirect vulnerability in several controllers that pass user-supplied _redirect or redirect_back parameters to redirect() without validating local paths. Attackers can craft links to endpoints like /tools/batch_eda_edit using scheme-relative or protocol-relative values that bypass the nelmio_security guard, sending authenticated victims to attacker-controlled phishing sites.

items.title: CVE-2026-136916
items.description: HortusFox (hortusfox-web) through 6.4 contains a password reset poisoning vulnerability in UserModel::restorePassword that builds reset links from the client-controlled Host header. Unauthenticated attackers can request a reset with a forged Host header to capture the victim's reset token and take over accounts including administrators.

items.title: CVE-2026-136915
items.description: HortusFox through 6.4 contains an information exposure vulnerability in BackupModule::start that allows unauthenticated attackers to download workspace backups stored in the public/backup directory. Attackers can enumerate one-second-precision creation timestamps used as filenames to retrieve archives containing locations, plants, gallery, tasks, inventory and calendar data.

items.title: CVE-2026-136914
items.description: JuggleIM im-server before 1.8.17 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to invoke the internal g_del_members operation by supplying it as a client topic. Attackers holding a valid connect token can send crafted WebSocket or HTTP publish requests with arbitrary group and member ids to remove any users from any group in the application.

items.title: CVE-2026-136913
items.description: JuggleIM im-server before 1.8.17 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated end users to invoke the internal upd_user_info operation because ImListenerImpl.PublishArrived forwards any client-supplied topic as the RPC method. Attackers holding a valid connect token can supply another user's id to UpdUserInfo to overwrite that user's nickname, portrait, extension fields and settings.

items.title: CVE-2026-136912
items.description: Paid Memberships Pro before 3.8.8 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read restricted post excerpts because restriction is reapplied only through the_excerpt filter. Attackers can request RSS or Atom feeds, oEmbed URLs, or pages rendering the Post Excerpt block to read opening text or manual excerpts of member-only posts.

items.title: CVE-2026-136911
items.description: Boost.JSON 1.75.0 through 1.92.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability in monotonic_resource::release() because it does not reset next_size_ when returning blocks upstream. Attackers can send repeated JSON documents larger than the initial block, growing allocation sizes geometrically until every later allocation fails with bad_alloc.

items.title: CVE-2026-136910
items.description: POCO C++ Libraries through 1.15.4 contain a denial of service vulnerability in InflatingStreamBuf::reset() that fails to clear stale buffered data from a previous failed stream. Attackers can supply one corrupt compressed stream to an application reusing an InflatingOutputStream, causing subsequent valid streams to fail decompression.

items.title: CVE-2026-136909
items.description: Assimp 5.1.0 through 6.0.6 contains a memory leak vulnerability in AMFImporter::ParseFile that overwrites the previous XML parser pointer without releasing it. Attackers can supply repeated AMF files to applications using a long-lived Assimp::Importer to retain parsed documents and exhaust memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-136908
items.description: libyang through 6.4.13 contains a release of invalid pointer vulnerability in ly_in_memory() and ly_in_memory_chunk() in src/in.c that return the current read position instead of the previous start address. Attackers supplying YANG data parsed from a heap buffer can cause applications freeing the returned pointer to pass an interior address to free(), aborting the process.

items.title: CVE-2026-136907
items.description: CESNET libyang through 6.4.13 contains a return of wrong status code vulnerability in ly_in_filepath() in src/in.c that reports success when a new file cannot be opened or mapped. Attackers who make an application switch a reused input handler to a nonexistent or empty file cause it to parse the previously loaded file's data as the requested input.

items.title: CVE-2026-136906
items.description: libyang through 6.4.13 contains a file descriptor leak in ly_in_new_filepath() and ly_in_filepath() in src/in.c that fails to close descriptors when file mapping fails. Attackers who can supply files parsed through lyd_parse_data_path() or lys_parse_path() can repeatedly submit empty files to exhaust descriptors, causing later file and socket operations to fail.

items.title: CVE-2026-136905
items.description: CESNET libyang through 6.4.13 contains an incomplete cleanup vulnerability in ly_out_reset() in src/out.c that tests a stale errno ESPIPE value after a successful seek. Applications reusing one output handler for different clients rewind but do not truncate the file, leaking leftover bytes of a previous client's output.

items.title: CVE-2026-136904
items.description: POCO C++ Libraries through 1.15.4 contain a denial of service vulnerability in InflatingStreamBuf::reset() and InflatingInputStream::reset() that fails to discard unconsumed compressed input after decompression errors. Attackers can supply one corrupt zlib, gzip or zip-deflate stream to applications reusing an InflatingInputStream, causing all later stream reads, including valid ones, to fail.

items.title: CVE-2026-136903
items.description: Open Babel through 3.2.1 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in OBForceField::Setup() that leaves stored constraints bound to freed atoms when set up with an empty molecule. Attackers can supply a molecule file yielding an empty molecule so later SteepestDescent() or ConjugateGradients() calls read freed memory, causing crashes or incorrect results.

items.title: CVE-2026-136862
items.description:
In Eclipse Apoapsis ORT Server Credential Helper versions 0.1.0 to 0.2.0, as shipped with Eclipse Apoapsis ORT Server versions 0.65.0 to 0.83.0, the Git credential helper selects stored credentials by re-parsing the requested URL with a regular expression that can be confused by `:` and `@` characters in the URL path. An attacker who can make an ORT Server worker fetch a crafted Git URL, for example through a submodule of a repository that is analyzed, can obtain credentials stored for a different host, such as `github.com`, which Git then sends to the attacker-controlled server.



The issue is fixed in Eclipse Apoapsis ORT Server Credential Helper 0.2.1 and Eclipse Apoapsis ORT Server 0.84.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-136694

It is suggested to upgrade the affected component. This is a regression of CVE-2026-51862 because the fix shipped in 0.8.1 was reverted in 0.8.2 and the corrected code exists only on the unreleased main branch.

items.title: CVE-2026-135844
items.description: The fix for CVE-2026-61801 added file type and size checks when parsing user and group files in github.com/moby/sys/user, but did not apply them consistently across all parsing and lookup functions. ParsePasswdFile, ParsePasswdFileFilter, GetAdditionalGroupsPath, ParseSubIDFile, ParseSubIDFileFilter, ParseIDMapFile, ParseIDMapFileFilter, LookupUser, LookupUid, LookupGroup and LookupGid could still read large or unbounded files. An attacker who controls the contents of a user or group file processed by an affected application, such as /etc/passwd or /etc/group from a container image, can cause excessive memory or CPU consumption, resulting in a denial of service. Exploitation depends on how the consuming application uses the affected functions. Fixed in v0.5.1 by enforcing the 10 MiB read limit in all affected functions. Docker Engine 29.10.1 includes the fix.

items.title: CVE-2026-135124
items.description: A race condition during docker cp mount setup in Docker Engine allows a malicious container to leave a read-only bind mount writable while an archive is extracted into the container. When copying files into a container, the daemon bind-mounts the container's volumes into a temporary view and applies the read-only flags afterwards, through a path inside the container's filesystem. A process in the container can change that path in between, so the flags are applied to a different mount and the intended bind mount stays writable for the duration of the copy.

items.title: CVE-2026-114347
items.description:
The phsuperpack module for PrestaShop is vulnerable to SQL injection in the /module/phsuperpack/pack endpoint. User-supplied input is used in database queries without proper sanitization. An authenticated, high privileged, remote attacker can exploit this by sending crafted input to read or modify data in the shop's database. Critically, because of CVE-2026-114346, this endpoint may be accessed without authentication.



This issue was fixed in version 3.0.26.

The controller at /module/phsuperpack/pack can be accessed without login, which allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to modify the module's data and create, edit, or delete products, including the complete deletion of a product with its translations, shop associations, stock, and images.



This issue was fixed in version 3.0.26.

items.title: CVE-2026-136881
items.description:
In the `setup-osc` GitHub Action of Eclipse Apoapsis, from commit 4e9eaff up to, but not including, commit 03efc4c, the ORT Server version returned by the `/api/v1/versions` endpoint is inserted into a shell script via a GitHub Actions expression without validation. An attacker who controls the responses of the configured ORT Server, for example by compromising the server, can execute arbitrary commands on the GitHub Actions runner and access the secrets available to the calling workflow.



The issue is fixed in commit 03efc4c, which only accepts version strings consisting of alphanumeric characters, `.`, `+`, and `-`.

items.title: CVE-2026-136863
items.description:
In Eclipse Apoapsis ORT Server versions 0.1.0 to 0.83.0, the file-based configuration providers do not restrict resolved file paths to the configured directory. An authenticated user who is allowed to trigger an ORT run for a single repository can use `../` sequences or absolute paths in `reporter-template://` references of the reporter job configuration to make the reporter worker read arbitrary files and include them in the generated reports. This discloses files such as environment variables, mounted secrets, and configuration files that contain credentials shared across all tenants of the server.



The issue is fixed in Eclipse Apoapsis ORT Server 0.84.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-136703
items.description: A flaw was found in the Admin REST API v2 of Keycloak. This component is used by administrators to manage realm configurations, including clients. The issue occurs because the API processes a client update (PUT) request and performs payload validation before verifying if the caller has the required permissions to view or manage that specific client. By sending a request with a mismatched client ID in the body, an authenticated user without any administrative privileges can distinguish between existing and non-existing clients based on whether the server returns a 400 Bad Request or a 403 Forbidden error.

items.title: CVE-2026-134791
items.description:
Since Symfony 7.2, expressions can contain comments. The lexer used a regular expression to find the end of a comment. When a /* was never closed, this regular expression scanned the rest of the expression, and the lexer then went on with the next character. So each /* scanned the rest of the expression again. Linting 192 KB of /*  took 9 to 11 seconds, and 96 KB took 34 seconds without PCRE JIT.

The lexer runs before the parser and its nesting limit. Any code that lints or parses untrusted expressions is affected, including the ExpressionSyntax validation constraint. A Length constraint on the same value doesn't help, since the validator runs both constraints.

The lexer now uses strpos() to find the end of a comment, and a comment that is never closed throws a SyntaxError. Such expressions were already invalid. Lexing takes linear time again.

items.title: CVE-2026-134790
items.description:
The fix for CVE-2017-16652 restricts the redirects of HttpUtils::createRedirectResponse() to the host of the request. When framework.session.cookie_domain is set, it also allows the subdomains of that domain. To check a target, it read the host of the URL up to the first "/". But browsers also end the host at "\", "?" and "#". So with the cookie domain .example.com, a target like https://evil.test?.example.com passed the check, and the browser went to evil.test.

Applications are exposed when framework.session.cookie_domain is set. The default success and failure handlers of form_login redirect to the _target_path or _failure_path of the request. A login link can then send the user to another site right after a successful login, for example to ask for the password again.

HttpUtils now ends the host of a target where browsers do, before checking it against the allowed domains.

When this variable isn't set, the cli, phpdbg and embed SAPIs default to the CLI mode, and errors are rendered with CliErrorRenderer. items.description:
CsvEncoder::decode() splits each header cell on the key separator, . by default, and nests the decoded rows one level per separator, with no limit. PHP frees nested arrays recursively, so freeing data that is nested deeply enough overflows the C stack and crashes the process. With a stack of 8 MB, a CSV body of 448 KB is enough.

Each row also builds all the levels of its headers again. With a deep header, a CSV body of 2 KB made of short rows allocates more than 128 MB. A body of 1 MB keeps the CPU busy for 10 seconds or more.

Any code that decodes untrusted CSV with the Serializer is affected. From Symfony 7.4.0, this included every #[MapRequestPayload] argument that doesn't restrict acceptFormat, until 7.4.23 and 8.1.11 stopped decoding CSV payloads by default.

items.title: CVE-2026-133760
items.description:
The fix for CVE-2026-109449 made the expression parser check the nesting level of long expressions. This check exists since Symfony 5.4.54, 6.4.48, 7.4.21 and 8.1.9. The parser builds a ?: b with the node of a used twice, and the check walked every path to every node. With nested short ternaries, the number of paths doubles at each level, so an expression of 256 bytes never finished parsing.

The expression needs no variable and no function. Any code that parses or lints untrusted expressions is affected, including the ExpressionSyntax validation constraint. evaluate() and compile() parse the expression first, so they hang too.

The nesting check now skips the nodes it already checked, so it takes linear time again. evaluate(), compile() and the messages of runtime errors now use the node of a once, so a is evaluated once, as in PHP.

items.title: CVE-2026-133753
items.description:
With the unanimous access decision strategy, an access_control rule that lists several roles requires all of them. That's the behavior restored by the fix for CVE-2020-5275. Since Symfony 5.4, the access decision manager asked each voter once about all the attributes of a rule. RoleVoter grants access as soon as the user has one of the roles. So a user who had only one of these roles was granted access:

security:
    access_decision_manager:
        strategy: unanimous
    access_control:
- { path: ^/admin, roles: [ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_AUDITOR] }

Only attributes decided by the same voter were affected. For example, a role combined with allow_if still required both.

With the unanimous strategy, voters are asked about each attribute separately again, as before Symfony 5.4. Access is denied as soon as one of the attributes is denied.
